root_cause: The 2024 refactor switched to a list of live jar pointers. The share lock still ended immediately after Curl_cookie_getlist, leaving the new traversal unprotected. The 2025 fix keeps the lock through traversal, but its surrounding http_cookies API postdates the 2024 tree; the intro-era companion must express the equivalent lock scope in Curl_http_cookies.
findings: The October 2024 cookie refactor returns live Cookie pointers. Curl_http_cookies releases CURL_LOCK_DATA_COOKIE after retrieving the list, before dereferencing its nodes. A concurrent HTTP Set-Cookie update on a shared handle can free a node during traversal.
